greeting: Hello! I am Sprout, your FreshFind Virtual Market Assistant. How can I help you discover fresh, local farmers markets today?
prompts: Which markets are open right now?
Where can I find organic heirloom tomatoes?
What produce is currently in season?
Are dogs allowed at the markets?
Where is the nearest honey vendor?

rules.response: Markets open on different days throughout the week! On weekends, **Green Valley Organic Market**, **Sunridge Hill Country Bazaar**, and **Northridge Heritage Orchard Market** are open early morning. On weekdays, check out **Eastside Community Growers Market** (Mon/Wed/Fri) and **Midtown Sunset Twilight Market** (Thu/Fri evenings until 8:30 PM). Use our 'Open Right Now' real-time indicator on the Home Page!

Fresh heirloom rainbow tomatoes and crisp leafy greens are available at **Green Valley Organic Market**, **Sunridge Hill Country Bazaar**, and **Eastside Community Growers**. Check our Produce Guide for seasonal peak months and storage tips!

Currently in season: Crisp Orchard Apples, Tuscan Kale, Wild Foraged Mushrooms, and Vine Tomatoes! Late spring and summer bring sweet strawberries and fragrant basil. Look for our 'Seasonal Picks' badges on market cards!
Yes! Both **Green Valley Organic Market** and **Midtown Sunset Twilight Market** are pet-friendly. Leashed, well-behaved dogs are warmly welcomed in outdoor walking lanes.
Many participating markets proudly accept EBT/SNAP food benefits, including **Green Valley Organic Market**. Many locations offer 'Double Up Food Bucks' matching up to $20 for fresh produce!
Pure raw wildflower blossom honey and artisan fruit preserves are featured at **Northridge Heritage Orchard Market** and **Green Valley Organic Market** directly from regional beekeepers.
You can bookmark any market or produce item by clicking the bookmark ribbon icon! You can also attach your own private shopping notes and export your list to a clean formatted file.

fallback: I'm here to help with farmers market schedules, seasonal produce recommendations, vendor products, and bookmarking. Try selecting one of the suggested questions above, or browse our Market Directory!
